evidence.claim: Avio progetta e costruisce dal 1912 lanciatori spaziali come Vega e missili tattici, con oltre 1.500 dipendenti tra Italia, Francia, Stati Uniti e Guyana francese.
evidence.quote: with more than 1,500 employees across Italy, France, the United States, and French Guiana. Since its founding in 1912 , the company has played a key role in the design, manufacturing, and integration of space launchers and tactical missiles. || Rivalta di Torino Production of liquid oxygen turbopumps Airola Carbon fiber impregnation laboratory Arlington, Virginia Headquarters of Avio Usa || The company offers competitive solutions for launching institutional, governmental and commercial payloads in Earth orbit through its Vega rocket family.
